notes: The posted registry results in doc_registry_NCT01897532.json were searched: outcomeMeasuresModule contains only the cardiovascular and renal composite outcomes; adverseEventsModule event terms and eventGroups contain no overall any-adverse-event outcome. Serious-event totals (linagliptin 1293; placebo 1343), other-event totals with a 5% reporting threshold (1434; 1422), and death totals (250; 253) are different outcomes and were not substituted or combined. The publication abstract explicitly reports overall adverse events in 2697 linagliptin and 2723 placebo patients; denominators 3494 and 3485 are printed in its Interventions sentence. The same counts are repeated in doc_ft_30418475.txt. Hypoglycemia and acute pancreatitis counts are specific harms, not the requested overall outcome.
